Definition: Abiram, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Abiram = "my father is exalted" or "(the) Exalted One is (my) father"; 1) a Reubenite, son of Eliab in exodus; 2) son of Hiel the Bethelite who worked to rebuild Jericho
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
